property_summary: For every call to Put by any address with a positive msg.value, the reference contract appends a Log.Message (increasing Log.History.length) while the mutant that removed the LogFile.AddMessage call will not increase Log.History.length for such calls (so there exist inputs with msg.value>0 where the mutant violates this).
change_summary: Replace the call to LogFile.AddMessage with no logging (delete that statement), altering externally observable history recorded by Log contract.
